title: Pregnant Solo #27
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Norwegian woman, an adult, in her mid 20s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest — and below it, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projecting forward from her long, powerful torso, its surface taut and round, with a slight inward taper still visible at her waist on either side of the belly. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair skin with a light scatter of freckles, strong straight defined dark-blonde brows, warm bronze shadow across the lids, a fine brown liner, long lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, soft contour, a muted red-brown lip, long pale-blonde hair in two thick braids and a braided crown, a fierce, steady, commanding expression, twin-tail hair, real pores, real living eyes, 5 hoops piercings set with sapphires in brass-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of platinum a bracelet. Full body painted in Norwegian rosemaling folk painting, a deep forest-green ground with bold cream and gold acanthus scrollwork, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the pattern reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps, wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of acanthus scrollwork wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's natural centrepiece, the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme gold extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
